svg.title: What stands behind CBTC
svg.desc: Bitcoin from a Taproot-capable wallet is sent to a P2TR deposit address unique to a deposit account. BitSafe's Attestor Network of independent institutional operators verifies the deposit after Bitcoin confirmations, and CBTC is minted to the depositor's Canton party. FROST threshold signing produces one Schnorr signature without the complete private key in one place. Redeeming burns CBTC and delivers Bitcoin to a withdrawal address. Source: BitSafe documentation.
